opis: The novel (work in progress) explores the lives of the “transitional generation,” whose adolescence coincided with the shift from socialism to capitalism, and examines how this historical rupture continues to shape their intimate relationships and sense of belonging.
uvod:
The story follows Kirsten, a painter and teacher born in East Berlin. After the death of her father, a once-renowned painter in the GDR, she inherits a painting that had been confiscated by the Stasi. The painting disappeared after the fall of the Berlin Wall, and Kirsten sets out on a journey to find it.

Along the way, she encounters Goran, a journalist still grappling with the aftermath of the breakup of socialist Yugoslavia, and Diogo, a musician whose adolescence was shaped by Portugal’s Salazar dictatorship.

As her journey unfolds, Kirsten confronts the emotional legacy of life under socialism and the transition that followed. Gradually, she begins to recognize the patterns that have shaped her emotional life and relationships.
knjiga: All the stories from this journey will flow into a book. Coming soon.
